title: The source principal completion adjunction
statement: On an essentially small site J with coefficients in a commutative ring R, let I be generated by a nonzerodivisor. The source derived completion functor into the full subcategory of derived I-complete objects is left adjoint to its inclusion.

source.place: Tag 099M, lemma-naive-completion; derived completion by the derived inverse limit of finite reductions

proof.text: Choose the homotopy limit of the finite derived reductions. The principal Koszul triangle shows that the cone of its natural augmentation has invertible generator. Complete objects are right orthogonal to these cones, so the distinguished triangle gives the universal Hom bijection. This is already proved by the source reflectorOfDistinguished construction.
